'''Team Alpha''' was a [[Galactic Alliance Security]] unit. They went with [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to the [[Temple of the Sith|Jedi Temple]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] to capture [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Seff Hellin]] and [[Natua Wan]], both of whom had developed an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]] and were being held by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>
